summary: Of 24 key details Brendan Dassey stated or agreed to across three recorded interviews, investigators introduced 13 first, four were already public before any interview, six originated with Dassey, and one (bleach on jeans) may trace to an earlier unrecorded statement. Five details were adopted by agreeing to investigator questions, and one detail (tattoo on stomach) was raised by investigators but never adopted. The record shows repeated use of "we already know" (52 instances), "demand truth" (85), and minimization (30) tactics across sessions.
key_points: Investigators stated 13 of 24 key details before Dassey did, including vehicle in garage (Feb 27, p. fassbender), knife (Feb 27, p. wiegert), body in RAV4 (Feb 27, p. fassbender), restrained on bed (Feb 27, p. wiegert), stabbed in stomach (Feb 27, p. fassbender), strangled (Mar 1, p. wiegert), throat cut (Feb 27, p. fassbender), shot in head (Mar 1, p. wiegert), tires/branches on fire (Feb 27, p. fassbender), RAV4 hidden (Feb 27, p. fassbender), license plates removed (Mar 1, p. wiegert), Avery raised hood (Mar 1, p. fassbender), and phone/camera/purse burned (Feb 27, p. fassbender).

Four details were publicly reported before any interview: body burned behind garage (Nov 16, 2005), license plates removed (Nov 16, 2005), vehicle key in bedroom (Nov 10, 2005), clothes burned (Nov 16, 2005).

Six details originated with Dassey in the record: tied up with rope (Feb 27, p. brendan), hair cut (Mar 1, p. brendan), shot with .22 rifle (Mar 1, p. brendan), shot inside garage (Mar 1, p. brendan), bedsheets burned (Mar 1, p. brendan), bones broken with shovel (Mar 1, p. brendan).

One detail (bleach on jeans) may trace to an earlier unrecorded statement on the evening of Feb 27, 2006 (Decision and Order p. 7, citing ECF 19-19 at 10-11); it first appears in transcripts at Mar 1, p. brendan.

Five details were adopted by agreeing to investigator questions: stabbed in stomach (Feb 27, p. brendan), throat cut (Mar 1, p. brendan), license plates removed (Mar 1, p. brendan), Avery raised hood (Mar 1, p. brendan), blood on garage floor (Mar 1, p. brendan).
Investigators raised a tattoo detail (Mar 1, p. fassbender) that Dassey never stated or agreed to.
limits: This audit only tracks where each detail first appears in the available transcripts and public records; it cannot assess whether Dassey had independent knowledge of any detail.
No public transcript exists for the Feb 27 evening session with Fassbender or the Two Rivers Police Dept. session; any disclosures there are not captured.
The audit does not evaluate the voluntariness or reliability of Dassey's statements, only their sequential origin in the record.
Counts reflect the 24 details selected for this audit; other statements in the interviews are not analyzed here.
